question: What is the meaning of number of life cycles in relation to products and materials?
description: The number of life cycles in relation to products and materials refers to the stages a product or material goes through from its creation to its disposal or recycling. This includes the various phases such as production, transportation, use, maintenance, and end-of-life options like recycling or disposal. Understanding the life cycles helps in assessing the environmental impacts and making informed decisions regarding the sustainability and efficiency of products and materials.
